title: Work | Alankara
metaDescription: Alankara, by Sri Sai Enterprises. Civil construction, earthwork and levelling, machine and material supply, and rammed earth and mud construction.

images.alt: A mixer truck at the ground level above the trench, its chute pouring concrete down into the reinforcement cage, workers watching at the edge.
A deep rectangular excavation with a poured base slab and a dense steel rebar cage, workers on the access ramp at the bottom.
An excavated pit with blinding slab and dense rebar grids set out for the foundation walls and slab, a hard hat resting on the steel.
A high view of the foundation pit: rebar cage around the walls and a separate column cage in the centre, cement bags and materials at the edges.
A concrete mixer truck at the top of the embankment, its chute reaching down to pour at the rebar foundation, workers watching the pour.
A mixer truck placing concrete by chute into a deep pit, rebar cage along the wall and formwork at the bottom of the excavation.
A backhoe loader trenching at an early earthworks site with a tractor and trailer behind, workers and palms around, an overcast sky.
A wide plot of graded land with a long boundary wall, ground levelled and pegged for the build under an overcast sky.
Terraced stone retaining walls built into a cut red-earth slope, with a small concrete block in the foreground.
A freshly struck concrete retaining wall with formwork seams and tie holes, a drain pipe at the top, compacted red earth below and a worker on the stair.
A backhoe loader working on the rubble of a partly demolished building on an urban site, workers and onlookers around.
Two excavators working the rubble pile at a demolition, dust rising, palm trees and onlookers beyond.
A steel frame on a concrete slab: yellow columns and dark beams over a yellow diamond-plate floor, with a scaffolding tower to the side.
Steel columns and beams standing on the slab of a new building, the road and traffic beyond and a makeshift scaffold at the edge.
Steel trusses being erected over concrete columns in yellow formwork, workers in vests below and a mobile crane behind.
Rows of steel columns with a curved roof truss being raised between two of them, a mobile crane on site and workers in the foreground.
Inside an industrial shed: a yellow road roller compacting the gravel sub-base between steel columns under a roof with skylights.
A multi-storey brick building under construction behind bamboo scaffolding, with a parked backhoe, gravel and a concrete mixer in the foreground.
The steel frame of a two-storey building with blockwork walls at the ground floor, people at the entrance and palms around.
The yellow steel framework of a two-storey building above grey block walls, a worker on the frame and plaster work at the base.
Workers laying turf across a steep earth embankment, the lower slope already greened and a truck loaded with turf at the crest.
A landscaped green slope with a drainage line across it and a worker dressing the surface, boundary wall and trees above.
A green open ground with a goal frame at the wall and trees along the boundary.
A finished tropical residence with flat roofs, glass walls and a large pool behind a textured stone wall, palms around.
A pool-side view of a finished single-storey residence with glass walls and sheer curtains, a terracotta privacy wall at the left and palms behind.
Single-storey pavilions with flat roofs and rust-toned cladding on a finished lawn, palms around and a string line on the grass.
